definitions.gloss: independent production; self-produced work; indie production
definitions.explanation: Creative work produced independently, without backing from a major studio, label, or publisher. Covers films, music, games, and other media made with personal or small-scale resources.

examples.japanese: {自主制作|じしゅせいさく}の{映画|えいが}を{撮|と}った。
{彼|かれ}は{自主制作|じしゅせいさく}のアルバムをネットで{販売|はんばい}している。
examples.english: He sells his self-produced album online.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}{時代|じだい}に{自主制作|じしゅせいさく}の{短編映画|たんぺんえいが}で{映画祭|えいがさい}に{入選|にゅうせん}したのがきっかけで、プロの{道|みち}に{進|すす}んだ。
examples.english: Getting selected at a film festival with an indie short film I made in college led me to pursue a professional career.

notes:
Composed of {自主|じしゅ} (independent, autonomous) and {制作|せいさく} (production, creation). Used across creative fields — film, music, animation, games — to distinguish works made independently from those backed by major companies. Often abbreviated in compound forms as {自主制作|じしゅせいさく}{映画|えいが} (indie film), {自主制作|じしゅせいさく}{盤|ばん} (indie release).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自主制作|じしゅせいさく}{映画|えいが}: independent film
- {自主制作|じしゅせいさく}アニメ: indie animation
- {自主制作|じしゅせいさく}ゲーム: indie game

SIMILAR WORDS:
- インディーズ: indies — the loanword equivalent, especially common in music (インディーズバンド)
- {同人|どうじん}: doujin — self-published fan works or original creations, typically in manga and game communities
- {自費出版|じひしゅっぱん}: self-publishing — specifically for books, where the author funds the printing
